summary.text: Stephanie Steiner is the Democratic candidate for Iowa House of Representatives District 5 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Republican Keith Glienke.
A nurse who runs a small farm near Sutherland, Steiner also ran in the 2026 Democratic primary for Iowa's 4th Congressional District and lost.

paragraphs.text: Stephanie Steiner was born in Athens, Alabama, and earned an associate degree from Northwest Iowa Community College in 2008.
She has worked as a nurse and, as of 2025, was affiliated with the Iowa Farmers Union.

In a 2025 Ballotpedia survey, written for her congressional campaign, Steiner described herself as a retired women's health nurse and mother of seven who runs a small goat livestock operation with her husband outside Sutherland.
Steiner lost the Democratic primary for Iowa's 4th Congressional District on June 2, 2026, and is on the November ballot for the state House.
